answer: In an agent economy, Sybil resistance uses cryptographic stake burning scaled across identity tiers. Like staking an orchard where each identity branch is a vine rooted to a validation terrace, registering $n$ colluding agents incurs an exponentially superlinear slash-and-burn penalty $C(n) \propto k^n$. This steep quadratic-to-exponential economic friction makes mass spoofing mathematically cost-prohibitive.
